channel.title: Harshan Karthikeyan
channel.description: I build AI systems for businesses. I write here about what I am building, how I think about it, and where it goes next.

item.title: 17th October 2026 - Reflection about my business
item.description: I pose myself some questions, such as how to stay relevant in the age of AI, how to stay balanced in the age of AI, and what systems I need so the business runs more autonomously.

item.title: Where I am at and where I'm going to go in the next 3 months
item.description: Reflections after a five-hour talk on thinking clearly. Six parts, thirty-three ideas, and the three I am holding myself to over the next three months.
